Alpha Caliper

The Alpha Caliper is a handheld precision caliper from Larkspur Instruments. It costs 59.00 GBP and is in stock, shipping within two working days.

Specifications

It measures 0 to 150.5 millimetres with a resolution of 0.01 millimetres, and weighs 240.0 grams in total.

In the box

The Alpha Caliper, a fitted case, and a calibration certificate.
